This Toilet Earth is the fourth album released by heavy metal band Gwar.
Released on March 29, 1994, this album was to be one of their oddest and most bittersweet albums.
It was the first Gwar album to be censored (the second was We Kill Everything, which comes in both censored and uncensored versions), due to their gain in popularity as a result of MTV exposure.
